study type: retrospective review and prospective cohort study
exposure: use of cesarean section for delivery
use of antiretroviral (ARV) therapy before delivery
adequacy of zidovudine prophylaxis to newborn
HIV diagnoses of expectant mothers prior to delivery
finding: Integrating public health and clinical services in the care of HIV-infected pregnant women and exposed infants leads to better coordination of care, improved quality of care, and a decrease in mother-to-child HIV transmission.
mod_finding: Increased use of cesarean section for delivery was associated with a decreased HIV transmission rate.
